additions.site_name: Serverfarm ARK Clarksville Data Center Campus (ARK1–ARK4)
additions.name: Serverfarm ARK Clarksville — campus construction, ARK1 structural topping-out

status.summary: Serverfarm’s October 30 article reports that construction continues at its Clarksville data-centre campus. It separately dates placement of the final structural beam on ARK1, the first building, to October 7. The observation supports an under-construction campus anchored at ARK1; structural topping-out is not whole-building completion, commissioning or operation.

locator.precision: Official FAA case point for Ironwood Building ARK1, directly published as WGS 84 and rounded to seven decimals. This filed building point anchors the Serverfarm Clarksville campus; it is not a surveyed building footprint, entrance or full-campus boundary. The case description and Serverfarm construction-team identity bind the point to ARK1. No local datum transform is performed.
locator.identity_review: All four baseline identity layers were searched: 1,278 sites, 1,387 projects, both 231 records and 231 decisions in identity-mapping.json, and 231 original source records. Serverfarm/Server Farm, Clarksville, ARK1–ARK4, SF ARK, Ironwood, Tech River Valley, Big Danger Road and both recorded parcel identifiers produced zero matches. The nearest existing host is TierPoint Little Rock, 119.649 km away; none is within 10 km. FAA case 2026-ASW-6954-OE names Ironwood Building ARK1 in Clarksville, identifies the Serverfarm Yates/Nabholz construction team, and describes the tract between Palmer and Big Danger Roads immediately south of State Highway 123. Its published WGS 84 point falls within Arkansas parcel 002-01630-000, recorded to SF ARK1 LLC, adjoining the same owner’s 002-01530-000 parcel. The operator names ARK1 as the first building of its Clarksville campus and separately presents ARK1–ARK4 as a phased development. One campus host and one construction project are added; individual buildings, ancillary generation, utility works and an unnamed prospective tenant are not counted separately.
locator.uncertainty_reason: FAA provides no per-point horizontal accuracy, original input datum, realization, epoch or conversion operation in the selected response. Published decimal precision is not survey accuracy.

The only later post, November 10, concerns a veteran’s career and contains no Clarksville status change. Current campus material still describes future completion of the first two buildings by January 2028. scoped_project_details.scope: One phased commercial colocation campus, anchored at its first building ARK1. October 7 structural topping-out and the October 30 continuing-construction statement remain distinct. No whole-campus completion or operational capacity is inferred.
scoped_project_details.location_description: Between Palmer Road and Big Danger Road, immediately south of State Highway 123, Clarksville, Johnson County, Arkansas.
scoped_project_details.capacity: No numeric commissioned capacity, floor area, investment or customer deployment is selected. Operator tables and future dates are retained as planning context.
scoped_project_details.future_only: The operator targets completion of the first two buildings by January 2028; future bond and power-procurement events do not imply completion or operation.
